# Li: semantic bindings available before record access

**No exact record-worksheet, record-column coordinate, row-coordinate class or reference-key join is established by the published evidence reviewed here.** The paper supports intended test-level meaning, endpoint vocabulary and units. Its two named documentary sheets are prospective identifiers to validate against the fixed archive, not an observed workbook inventory. The notebook projection supplies syntax categories only. This source-only note makes no actual source operation, C binding or scientific admission.

| Proposed binding | Supported documentary claim and exact locator | Still unresolved before C |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Source object | P1 identifies the paper; P3 identifies author repository commit `d19b15127c8ae1be49308c29eac718b609ad895c`. P4 identifies Materials Cloud v3 `vywsz-wxn79`, DOI `10.24435/materialscloud:ws-8j`. | These are separate objects. The Git workbook is 187,208 bytes versus the archive's declared 183,878; the notebook is not evidence that their contents or layouts coincide. Do not substitute the repository workbook. |
| Documentary worksheet names | P1, Data Records `Sec11`, names `References` and `Column Descriptions`. P2 independently checks that documentary account. | Actual occurrence, exact archive binding, hidden-sheet coverage, workbook order and other sheet names require A. These two labels do not by themselves authenticate a sheet's contents. |
| Record worksheet identity | No exact record-sheet name, relationship ID, ordinal or internal member path is supplied by P1–P4 or N1. | Every non-documentary sheet must come from A's complete validated manifest. Neither a name such as `Data`, the first sheet nor a sole remaining sheet establishes scientific role. |
| Record columns | P1 `Sec9`/`Sec11` describes property categories, not record column letters or indices. N1's `read_excel` values are withheld. | No endpoint, condition or reference column coordinate is justified. Dictionary cell position/order, a dictionary item number or the 54/55 descriptions must not become a record-column binding. A literal label is not automatically a unique coordinate or an alias. |
| Row role and joint unit | P1/P2 `Sec11` describes each row as one retrieved tensile test. | No concrete header/data/note/summary row coordinates, start/end rows, empty-row policy or specimen identity are established. Intended test-level meaning does not prove actual pairing, a physical replicate or independent sampling. |
| Endpoint meaning and units | P1/P2 `Sec9`/`Sec11`: yield and ultimate tensile strength in MPa; uniform and total elongation in percent. | These are semantic vocabulary, not authenticated literal headers. Yield offset, engineering/true convention, gauge/elongation definition, shared test conditions and actual cell validity/completeness remain unresolved. `Sec6`'s “ultimate elongation” is not silently mapped to a distinct or synonymous endpoint. |
| Conditions and dimensions | P1/P2 `Sec11`: Celsius for test temperature, inverse seconds for strain rate, millimeters for length dimensions, weight percent for composition; aspect ratios are separate. | No record coordinates, mandatory fields, missing-value codes or per-row applicability are bound. Do not assign millimeters to dimensionless aspect ratios or fill unknown conditions. |
| Reference role and keys | P1/P2 `Sec11` documents a source-article category; R1 preserves the paper-local citation graph. | The workbook reference key's field, storage type, numbering scheme and join are unknown. Article IDs such as `CR49` are article-local identifiers, not demonstrated workbook keys. Matching a DOI alone is unsafe: R1/R2 preserve the CR49/CR50 duplicate printed DOI and unresolved bibliographic differences. |
| Provenance and shared sources | P1/P2 `Tab2` distinguishes Data Source from Dataset and points to secondary sources/ranges; R1 preserves those separate documentary edges. | No record-to-reference, paper-to-campaign, heat/batch/specimen or repeated-measurement mapping is established. A citation edge is not verified measurement overlap; source counts do not establish independent units. |
| Missingness and transformations | P1/P2 `Sec7` describes unit conversions, some speed/length-derived strain rates and composition closure; `Sec11` notes missing treatment/irradiation metadata. `Sec12` describes expert/outlier work. | No executed per-row transformation, numeric missingness encoding, deleted-row log, imputation policy or executable outlier rule is bound. The notebook's `dropna` syntax cannot supply these. |
| Shape/count reconciliation | P1/P2 preserve 1,050 prose records/55 columns and a 1,038 sum of Table 2's 24 displayed counts; P3/P4 describe 1,070 records/54 parameters. | The counting bases and version relation remain unresolved. None supplies a correct archive row range, a missing column, a truncation rule or an independence count. |
| Notebook implementation | N1 `/inventory`: NumPy/pandas/matplotlib imports; syntactic `read_excel` and `dropna`; literal-scalar expression categories for positional argument 1, `header`, `skiprows`. N2 documents the execution limits. | Literal values, arbitrary names and other calls are withheld; runtime binding/execution is false. No default-sheet inference, header number, skipped-row count, column meaning, exclusion rule or grouping follows. Even `unreported_arguments_present=false` does not prove a pandas call resolved or executed. |

Source IDs and exact file/commit/blob hashes are recorded in [source-bindings.json](source-bindings.json). P1 is the [published paper audit](../../reports/phase2-li-paper-methods-v1/README.md); P2 is its [independent documentary review](../../reports/phase2-li-paper-methods-v1/independent-review/findings.md); P3 is the [pinned author audit](../../reports/phase2-li-author-methods-v1/README.md); P4 is the [archive metadata audit](../../reports/phase2-source-readiness-v1/li-metadata/README.md). R1/R2 are the [article citation projection](../../reports/phase2-li-reference-identity-v1/article-citation-projection.json) and [identity audit](../../reports/phase2-li-reference-identity-v1/README.md). N1/N2 are the [closed notebook projection](../../reports/phase2-notebook-header-verification-v1/public-notebook/1.json) and [its published interpretation](../../reports/phase2-notebook-header-verification-v1/README.md).

The accepted [complete-route amendment](../phase2-li-complete-route-amendment-v1/decision.json) supplies the appropriate prospective disposition. A must disclose the complete validated worksheet manifest, including hidden sheets. B may expose the two documentary roles under its already frozen disclosure rules. For each proposed semantic binding, preserve the B documentary cell location and literal assertion, the specific record sheet/column/row role it actually identifies, and any version/qualification. Text that merely names a field or gives a dictionary row index is insufficient to identify a record column. Unclear numeric/nontext keys, illustrative examples and dictionary-internal coordinates remain unresolved; they do not authorize a guess. No additional preview is proposed here.

Before either C invocation, freeze one reviewed binding against the complete A/B lineage. Explicit documentary evidence may justify individual semantic fields without establishing every other premise. Unsupported record sheets use `STRUCTURAL_ONLY_UNASSIGNED`; empty semantic bindings must not masquerade as readiness. Retain every explicit row and use `UNRESOLVED` where no row class is justified; do not invent exceptions from numeric appearance. Any such unresolved sheet, row or required meaning forces the accepted completed negative `NO_GO_UNRESOLVED_PREMISE`. C's repeated invocation uses the same frozen binding; its contents must not be used to adapt and rerun. The [feasibility review](../phase2-li-frame-feasibility-review-v1/README.md) explains these distinctions.

Structural accounting, a recorded-label description and physical future prediction are different claims. A fixed-archive descriptive estimand does not require physically independent specimens merely to exist, nor does a uniform finite-frame audit inherit an IID physical premise. It still needs correctly identified stored units, labels and a fixed estimand/frame. None is supplied by notebook syntax or dictionary order. This note establishes neither recorded pairs nor G21 fresh paired screening, and preserves all earlier scientific negatives.

Only public project reports/projections and the two named prospective design files were read. No raw workbook or notebook, private projection, new full-text body or network source was accessed; no notebook or product code, study, test or actual reader was run. Researcher-visible material here includes already published documentary counts, units and citation metadata. Earlier full-article and notebook-container machine exposure remains disclosed; this review does not restore blindness. A separate agent independently cross-checked N1/N2/P3 and the public notebook capture receipt without raw access; [cross-check.json](cross-check.json) records the bounded result. Agent agreement is documentary review, not additional scientific evidence or statistical independence.
